description.en: The ID of the enterprise drive.

description.zh: 用户名。`EndUserId`和`GroupId`必须至少传入一个。
description.en: The username. You must specify at least one of `EndUserId` and `GroupId`.

description.zh: 团队空间ID。`EndUserId`和`GroupId`必须至少传入一个。
description.en: The ID of the team space. You must specify at least one of `EndUserId` and `GroupId`.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the list of regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise is available.

description.zh: 文件上传任务的ID。可调用接口[CreateCdsFile](~~2247619~~)获取。
description.en: The ID of the file upload task. Callable interface [CreateCdsFile](~~2247619~~).
